verdicts.reason: A: the black panel has shrunk to a small box showing only 'MOVIE NIGHT' and two empty divider lines. All the other copy (title, tagline, date, venue, URL) is white text scattered over the busy doodle background and can't be read, so the event message is lost. B is worse: the panel is a tiny 'MOVIE NIGHT' tag in the bottom-left over the cinema doodle, and all the white copy is piled up and overlapping near the top on the busy art. A at least keeps a readable 'MOVIE NIGHT' block at a sensible size.
